method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reconstruction of the structure/assignment/satisfaction dependency chain, replay of the validity, entailment and satisfiability quantifier patterns, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Introductory account of structures, domains, symbol and variable assignments, satisfaction, sentences and the three basic semantic notions.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A structure gives a first-order vocabulary meaning by supplying a nonempty domain, domain elements for constants, self-maps for functions and domain relations for predicates. A variable assignment supplies domain elements for variables. Satisfaction of a formula is then defined relative to both a structure and an assignment by induction on formula construction; for sentences the assignment is irrelevant.
samples.checks: The nonempty-domain condition, symbol-class interpretations, variable-assignment role, relative satisfaction notation, inductive dependence on connective truth tables and no-free-variable reason for assignment independence are all retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A sentence is valid when every structure satisfies it, follows semantically from Gamma when every structure satisfying all of Gamma also satisfies it, and a sentence set is satisfiable when one structure satisfies every member simultaneously. Induction can then establish properties and relationships among these notions.
samples.checks: Universal versus existential structure quantification, simultaneous satisfaction, the two displayed entailment forms and the formula-structure induction claim are preserved.

source_observations: The translation keeps model-theoretic validity and entailment distinct from proof-theoretic derivation.
The quantifier-domain sentence avoids reusing the syntactic scope term for semantic ranging.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The edition-wide चिन्हार्थमीमांसा and तार्किक निष्पन्नता choices remain explicitly open to specialist review in T012 and T123.
